def transform(grid):
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    h, w = len(g), len(g[0])
    # Horizontal bars are rows containing a repeated adjacent color.
    stripes = [r for r in range(h) if any(g[r][c] != 0 and g[r][c] == g[r][c+1] for c in range(w-1))]
    # Fill gaps between portions of the same horizontal bar.
    for r in stripes:
        c = 0
        while c < w:
            if g[r][c] != 0:
                c += 1
                continue
            a = c
            while c < w and g[r][c] == 0:
                c += 1
            if a > 0 and c < w and g[r][a-1] == g[r][c]:
                for x in range(a, c):
                    g[r][x] = g[r][a-1]
    if not stripes:
        return g
    last = max(stripes)
    # Vertical guide columns are encoded below the lowest horizontal bar.
    guides = {}
    for c in range(w):
        vals = [g[r][c] for r in range(last+1, h) if g[r][c] != 0]
        if vals:
            # The guide is a single-color vertical stem.
            guides[c] = vals[-1]
    for c, stem in guides.items():
        crossings = [(r, g[r][c]) for r in stripes if g[r][c] != 0]
        if not crossings:
            continue
        # Each horizontal bar's color propagates upward to the previous crossing.
        for i, (r, color) in enumerate(crossings):
            start = 0 if i == 0 else crossings[i-1][0] + 1
            for y in range(start, r+1):
                g[y][c] = color
        for y in range(crossings[-1][0]+1, h):
            g[y][c] = stem
    return g
PY
